network_status.highlight: Glamsterdam devnet: Nimbus, Erigon, Lighthouse, Grandine, and Besu nodes offline; client teams asked to investigate
Sepolia post-fork: stable, all node operators synced, near 100% participation
JochemNet shadow fork v2 launched post-fork with 64KB contracts for benchmarking; Snap 2 sync issues found in multiple clients on v1

client_releases.highlight: Hoodi client releases due by Friday October 16th; Lodestar already published v1.50.0

proposer_selection_bug.highlight: Spec bug reported: proposer can self-slash to manipulate compute shuffle index and influence future epoch proposer selection
Consensus: exploit is difficult, requires self-slash, and not worth fixing in Glamsterdam; defer to Hegota if at all

hardware_specs_eip7870.highlight: EIP-7870 min specs are wrong for Glamsterdam: current 500 MB/s sequential read/write too low; jochem recommends raising to 2000 MB/s
Consensus: keep EIP-7870 as a living document (not fork-per-EIP); update with fork-specific history sections
Lukasz: random 4K IOPS matter more than sequential MB/s for EVM workloads; worst-case block must be handled by spec hardware

hegota_devnet_planning_cl.highlight: Proposed heze-devnet-2 (CL-only): EIP-7805 (FOCIL), EIP-8015 (remove eth1data), EIP-8365 (disallow 0x00 validators), EIP-8198 (quick slots at 12s)
Quick slots (EIP-8198) kept at 12s for devnet; 10s slot duration deferred pending broader client readiness
Teku, Lodestar, Lighthouse have quick slots implemented; Nimbus unlikely to join if 10s slots required
Devnet naming scheme agreed: focil-devnet-* → heze-devnet-*, frames-devnet-* → bogota-devnet-*

el_breakout_bogota_devnet_1.highlight: bogota-devnet-1 EIPs: EIP-8141, EIP-8250, EIP-8272, EIP-7906 (frames, keyed nonces, recent roots, transaction assertions)
Spec clarification: keyed nonces are regular state added to BAL; floor gas pricing over full tx envelope changes call data cost when combined with frames
ethrex and Nethermind already passing tests-frames-devnet@v1.0.0; new tag B1.1.0 to include keyed nonce consensus change

el_breakout_next_devnet_eips.highlight: EIP-8253 (nonce bump) should go in next devnet; behavior only triggers at fork transition, needs early testing on all devnets
Strong community support to include SETCODEFROM, data repricing (EIP-8279), nonce bump, and deactivate self-destruct in bogota-devnet-2
jochem: if deactivate self-destruct ships, EIP-8360 (TCREATE) should be prioritized alongside it to avoid economic disruption

action_items.action: Notify Alex Stokes when Hoodi releases are ready for blog post
Open PR to add EIP-8253 test accounts to devnet genesis template
Confirm bogota-devnet-2 EIP scope (SETCODEFROM, data repricing, nonce bump, deactivate self-destruct) on next call

decisions.decision: Proposer selection bug deferred to Hegota (or later); no fix in Glamsterdam
EIP-7870 remains a living document; update in place with fork-specific history rather than creating per-fork EIPs
All focil-devnet-* renamed to heze-devnet-*, all frames-devnet-* renamed to bogota-devnet-*
heze-devnet-2 slot duration stays at 12 seconds; quick slots (EIP-8198) included but not yet at 10s
bogota-devnet-1 test release to tag B1.1.0 including keyed nonce consensus change; launch targeting Thursday

targets.target: October 16th — Hoodi client releases due; blog post publication
October 28th latest — heze-devnet-2 launch (3+ CL clients required)
